sample_data.Objective: Help your baby develop sensory awareness and tactile exploration
sample_data.Materials: • Soft cloths• Wooden rings• Soft balls• Baby blanket
sample_data.Steps: 1. Place soft cloths and objects in front of baby2. Encourage gentle touching and grasping3. Observe reactions4. Swap objects for variety5. Clean up
sample_data.Skills: • Sensory awareness• Tactile exploration• Fine motor development
sample_data.Explanation: Create a safe space with varied textures for baby to touch and explore
sample_data.Additional Information: • Great for bonding• Can repeat multiple times a day

sample_data.Objective: Introduce color and texture recognition through hands-on play
sample_data.Materials: • Soft mats• Fabric pieces of different colors• Small soft toys
sample_data.Steps: 1. Spread fabric pieces on mat2. Place baby on mat3. Let baby touch and grasp different fabrics4. Encourage reaching for toys5. Praise attempts
sample_data.Skills: • Color recognition• Fine motor skills• Hand-eye coordination
sample_data.Explanation: Use colorful fabrics to stimulate visual and tactile senses
sample_data.Additional Information: • Indoor-friendly• Helps develop reaching and grasping skills

sample_data.Objective: Encourage auditory and tactile exploration simultaneously
sample_data.Materials: • Soft rattles• Plush toys• Cloth strips
sample_data.Steps: 1. Shake rattles near baby2. Let baby touch different textured cloths3. Encourage grasping toys4. Repeat with different sounds5. Clean up
sample_data.Skills: • Auditory discrimination• Tactile exploration• Attention span
sample_data.Explanation: Combine gentle sounds with touch to stimulate multiple senses

sample_data.Objective: Stimulate tactile curiosity through safe, touchable bags
sample_data.Materials: • Ziplock bags• Water beads• Soft fabrics• Small rattles

sample_data.Objective: Develop hand-eye coordination and tactile exploration
